title: Assignment and Compound Assignment
learningObjectives: Explain assignment and compound assignment in C++.
Identify the operators, operands and result types involved.
Predict an expression's result by tracing it.
Use the topic in a focused program.
Avoid common mistakes and choose a clear alternative.

understand.concept: = assigns a value; compound forms +=, -=, *=, /= and %= perform an operation and store the result. The left side must be modifiable.
understand.whyItMatters: Accurate expression understanding prevents logic errors and improves safety, readability and maintainability.
understand.explain: Study assignment and compound assignment through the rule summary and examples; trace values carefully and note type and edge-case constraints.
